cards.headline:
An AI clone stands in
for the on-camera shoot
cards.body: Curious Refuge shows how recorded audio and a reference video can yield on-camera footage without a studio.

blocks.x: Curious Refuge walks through a realistic AI-clone workflow for video production.
The process starts from two inputs: a recorded audio track and a reference video of the presenter. From these, the workflow produces on-camera footage without booking a studio or setting up a shoot.
